name: product_polarity
description: Determine positive/negative polarity of a product of signed integers, with matched operand magnitude control.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[]; control=[]
for i in range(120):
 n=random.choice([2,3,4]); vals=[random.choice([-1,1])*random.randint(1,30) for _ in range(n)]; expr=' * '.join(('+' if x>0 else '-')+str(abs(x)) for x in vals); prod=1
 for x in vals: prod*=x
 items.append({'prompt':f'Expression: {expr}\nIs the product positive or negative? Answer:', 'answer':' '+('positive' if prod>0 else 'negative')})
 control.append({'prompt':f'Expression: {expr}\nWhat is the absolute value of the first operand? Answer:', 'answer':' '+str(abs(vals[0]))})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
